summary: The registrant filed an 8-K containing Items 7.01 and 8.01, announcing a regular distribution of $0.1887 per share, a net asset value (NAV) update ($24.69 per share, aggregate NAV ~$802.8M), and status of a continuous public offering of up to $2.0B in shares. No M&A, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic update with no transactional event. What to watch: no risk-arb angle applicable.
